review.scope: Original source author review of physical N1904 and exact installed/publisher BSB wording. Independent peer pending.

3:1.sourceText: Ἐν δὲ ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις παραγίνεται Ἰωάνης ὁ βαπτιστὴς κηρύσσων ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τῆς Ἰουδαίας,
3:1.targetText: In those days John the Baptist came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea

groups.note: Actual present nonactive arrival predicate is rendered as English past; preserve actual paraginomai and present form.
Actual genitive place noun is expressed with English of plus the same name; no separate Greek of preposition is printed.

unmappedSource.reason: English omits the actual narrative de.
These printed Greek articles are unexpressed in the local English noun, modifier or infinitive phrases.

3:2.sourceText: λέγων Μετανοεῖτε· ἤγγικεν γὰρ ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν.

groups.note: Actual perfect active drawing-near predicate supplies English present state is-near; no independent Greek copula is printed.

3:3.targetText: This is he who was spoken of through the prophet Isaiah:  “A voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for Him.’”

groups.note: Actual passive saying participle describes the person referred to; English adds the finite passive and of relation, retaining actual participle/case.
Actual genitive calling participle is expressed as an English nominal participant phrase; actual nonfinite form remains and no separate Greek one pronoun is invented.
Actual genitive Lord complement of way is rendered as English for-the-Lord. Actual genitive noun remains; no independent Greek for or article is written at this noun.
Actual genitive path-owner becomes English for-Him complement of paths, retaining the same referent and actual genitive pronoun; no Greek for preposition is invented.

unmappedSource.reason: English omits the actual explanatory gar and the saying participle introducing the quotation.
These printed Greek articles are unexpressed in the local English noun, modifier or infinitive phrases.

3:4.targetText: John wore a garment of camel’s hair, with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.

3:5.targetText: People went out to him from Jerusalem and all Judea and the whole region around the Jordan.

groups.note: Actual nominative city is a coordinated going-out subject; English names people from that city. Retain actual place/case and the changed construction.

3:10.sourceText: ἤδη δὲ ἡ ἀξίνη πρὸς τὴν ῥίζαν τῶν δένδρων κεῖται· πᾶν οὖν δένδρον μὴ ποιοῦν καρπὸν καλὸν ἐκκόπτεται καὶ εἰς πῦρ βάλλεται.

groups.note: Actual already plus lying/being-laid predicate is rendered English lies-ready. Retain actual temporal adverb and keimai nonactive verb, without an actual ready adjective.

Actual present passive cutting-down predicate becomes English future passive; retain actual present V-PPI-3S/form V-PEI-3S.

unmappedTarget.reason: English supplies an article before the fire; actual N1904 and TR write a bare fire noun.
